posts.trend: Google Dismisses Mass Layoff Rumours In India, Says Only 30 Cloud Roles Cut: "Totally Inaccurate"
posts.context: Every time management sends a reassuring memo dismissing layoff rumours, the next calendar invite from HR triggers instant panic.
posts.angle: A manager assuring you the layoff news is exaggerated is the clearest warning sign to start backing up your laptop.

landing_options.line: Kal 9 baje se pehle resume update kar lena.
"Quick sync" ke aage kabhi acchi khabar nahi aati.
30 mein 31wa naam kisi ka bhi ho sakta hai.
Jab manager bole tension mat lo, tabhi payslip download karte hain.

slides: Manager ne bola: "Tension mat lo, layoff rumours fake hain."

Voice note (0:47):
"Haan woh news mein jo aa raha hai na, woh bas 30 log the. Apne team mein kuch nahi hai. Waise kal 9 baje ek quick sync rakha hai HR ke saath."
Kal 9 baje se pehle resume update kar lena.
posts.caption: Send this to the teammate who immediately starts downloading payslips when HR sends a calendar invite.

messages.text: News dekha? 30 log nikale hain apne India office mein.
Haan manager ne bola rumours fake hain. Par kal 9 AM HR sync bheja hai.
Personal laptop mein saare payslips save kar le abhi.

posts.rank_verdict: Mentioning a 9am quick sync with HR in slide 2 already delivers the punchline, making the resume line an expected follow-up.
